data.name: ExternalTextReviewStatus
data.value: Text was received from the platform share or drop surface. Review it before sending.

data.name: SharedSourcesUnavailable
data.value: Shared files or folders were unavailable

data.name: SharedSourcesReadyFormat
data.value: {0:N0} shared file(s) and {1:N0} folder(s) ready to send

data.name: ExternalSourcesReviewStatus
data.value: Shared/dropped sources are selected locally. Review the selection and verify a receiving device before sending.

data.name: FolderPickerUnavailableDetailed
data.value: This platform does not currently expose a SwiftDrop folder picker without broader storage integration. You can still choose multiple files or use a share surface where supported.

data.name: FolderRecursiveStatus
data.value: The folder will be enumerated recursively when sending. Empty directories are not transferred because SwiftDrop transfers file content and relative paths.

data.name: DeviceIdentityRefreshedFormat
data.value: SwiftDrop created a new local device ID and certificate because the previous certificate could not be safely reused ({0}). Other devices that trusted the previous certificate must pair with this device again. Received files, transfer history, and your local trusted-device list were not deleted.

data.name: TransferFailedNotification
data.value: A transfer failed. Open SwiftDrop to review the status.

data.name: NotificationSupportAndroid
data.value: Android completion/failure notifications are opt-in. Android 13+ notification permission is requested only when you enable this setting and save.

data.name: NotificationSupportApple
data.value: Apple completion/failure notifications are opt-in. SwiftDrop requests alert and sound permission only when you enable this setting and save.

data.name: NotificationSupportWindows
data.value: Windows completion/failure app notifications are opt-in and contain only generic transfer status, not filenames or transfer contents.

data.name: NotificationSupportUnavailable
data.value: Optional completion/failure system notifications are not implemented on this target. Transfer status remains available inside SwiftDrop.
